note: The whole history of a real pump.fun creator wallet with a short one: getSignaturesForAddress listed fewer than 80 signatures, and every one that did not fail was read with getTransaction (encoding json, maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1) from https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com on 2026-09-25, newest first as the RPC listed them. The sum of every balance change they show equals the wallet's final balance, so no failed transaction that cost a fee is missing. Found by reading the creators of coins pump.fun listed as recently traded and keeping those whose history holds a collect_creator_fee. Not an agency wallet: test-hq-ledger.mjs reads it as if it were one.
